Ventanilla (Philippine architecture).question: The _____ was Feature in Philippine architecture.
Ventanilla (Philippine architecture).fact: In Philippine architecture, the ventanilla is a small window or opening below a larger window's casement, created—often reaching the level of the floor—to allow either additional air into a room during hot days or some air during hot nights when the main window's panes are drawn. It also allows for more light to strike the floor.
